description.what: Creator Fee allocates part of the trading fees to the token creator for project operations. The accumulated fees can be claimed directly on nad.fun.
how: When trades occur, part of the allocated fees is accumulated.
Claim access is assigned to the wallet connected when the token is created.
The accumulated fees are not paid out automatically and can be claimed directly on nad.fun.
rules: Claim access is assigned to the wallet connected at token creation.
The recipient wallet address cannot be changed after creation except when the community takes over the token.
CTO (Community takeover) requests can be submitted via Discord ticket and are reviewed at Nad.fun's discretion.
Fees are not paid out automatically and must be claimed manually.
description.importantNote: The wallet connected at token creation becomes the fixed wallet for Creator claims. Make sure to use the correct wallet for project operations.
